provenance.json records the exact upstream commit and original fixture hashes.
Approval/status labels remain unchanged in manifest.ttl. These draft tests are
not a certification or endorsement by W3C.

The current Rust harness executes 18 simple-entailment cases without additional
datatype recognition. It explicitly reports the remaining simple case
(opaque-literal, which requests xsd:integer value comparison) as unsupported.
RDF/RDFS cases and its included RDF 1.1 suite are retained coverage obligations;
they are not counted as passing by this harness. The parser is test-only and
does not supply a secondary reasoning implementation.
